name: avenue_markings
author: netmod (task avenues)
description: The stock straight avenue (11204) with white dashed lane lines instead of the yellow centre line (owner, 2026-10-17: on avenues every lane gets a white dashed line). Pattern from stock highway 73: four dashes per cell. Built by `py -3 ../../avenue_markings.py build .` in this folder before install (art/ is made from the game's frames and is not shipped). 11203 is the stock plain-road curve and is NOT reskinned (it leaked dashes onto every road corner, owner 2026-10-22); avenue ends and corners get their dashed 11203 art from avenue_lanes' 21701 / 21726. Layer 1 of 11204 (the median trees) stays stock.
